decisions.reason: A cheap accessory with little sunk investment or public commitment, it is easy to drop, but it costs almost nothing to carry and still fits the accessories and spare-parts range.
The box trailer line represents substantial investment and prominent public commitment in the core business, and the pandemic-era demand for trailers lets management treat any weakness as temporary.
The low-bed series is central to the announced core range, and the costs sunk into its tooling and models favor continuing it.

The high-cover series builds on core platforms and was showcased publicly, so withdrawing it would contradict earlier visible decisions, though covers are easier to rationalize away than whole trailer lines.
Its overlap with line B makes consolidation plausible over time, but the firm's public commitment and the strong trailer market argue for keeping it for now.
